title: PowerShell Prelude
subtitle: A cross-platform PowerShell standard library for sustainable scripting

sections.mission: Extend PowerShell with reusable tools for automation, mathematics, data analysis and sustainable scientific scripting.
sections.challenge: PowerShell users repeatedly rebuild common utilities for data shaping, numerical work, text processing and automation.
approach: Provide a dependency-free module of tested functions, aliases, types and type extensions.
Document practical examples spanning scripting, statistics, graph operations and linear algebra.
impact: Make analytical and scientific workflows easier to inspect, reuse and maintain.

research.focus: Sustainable cross-platform scripting and scientific analysis with PowerShell
